inferred_rules: "Not null for current rows; same AccountNumber may appear in multiple SCD2 versions; used to enforce exactly-one-current per AccountNumber."

documented_rules: DimAccount.PartySk → DimParty.PartySk (referential integrity to party dimension).

inferred_rules: "ProductCode should reference an active product version for the account's effective date; not null for most accounts."

business_meaning: Maturity date for term deposits; NULL for non-term products.

inferred_rules: If populated then AccountMaturityDate > AccountOpenDate; may be NULL for savings/current; should not be in the past for newly issued term deposits beyond business policy (NOT_FOUND in docs for exact policy).
